info.title: Junto server API
info.description: The public application API of a Junto server. Every route is under the version prefix, except the server information route, which tells a client which versions the server supports.

post.summary:
Asks the people inside a locked or full voice channel to let the caller in. The request
expires after 60 seconds.

default.description: An error. The field `error.code` states which one.

post.summary:
Invites a member who has access to the voice channel that the caller is in. The
invitation passes the lock and the user limit of the channel, and no permission. It
expires after 60 seconds.

default.description: An error. The field `error.code` states which one.

post.summary:
Asks for the place of the caller in the call of a voice channel. The answer carries the
address of the media server and a join token that is valid for about one minute. The
caller needs sight of the channel; a lock or a full channel stops a caller whom nobody
inside has accepted. A call of the account on another device, or in another place, ends.

default.description: An error. The field `error.code` states which one.

put.summary:
Locks the voice channel that the caller is in: only people who are invited, moved in or
accepted by a person inside enter until the channel is empty or unlocked.

default.description: An error. The field `error.code` states which one.

delete.summary: Unlocks the voice channel that the caller is in.

default.description: An error. The field `error.code` states which one.

put.summary:
Turns meeting mode on in the voice channel that the caller is in. The caller shares a
screen that the media server lists. Every other microphone is blocked.

default.description: An error. The field `error.code` states which one.

delete.summary:
Turns meeting mode off. Only the person who runs it does this, from inside the call. Every
microphone block in the voice channel is removed.

default.description: An error. The field `error.code` states which one.

delete.summary: Removes a person from the call of a voice channel.

default.description: An error. The field `error.code` states which one.

delete.summary:

default.description: An error. The field `error.code` states which one.

post.summary:
Moves a person from the call of one voice channel into another voice channel, without a
prompt. The device of the person joins the destination first; the person leaves the
source when the server has seen that join. A move that does not complete in 30 seconds

put.summary:

is starting or runs, the answer carries that one and nothing changes.

delete.summary:
Stops the recording of the call of a voice channel. The caller is in the call and holds
`record_calls`. The recorder ends every job, so that the files are complete; the recording
keeps the state `recording` until then. Without a recording nothing changes.

AccountProfile.description: What an account shows of itself to the accounts that may see it.

AccountSummary.description: An account as a moderator sees it.

ApproveDeviceLink.description: The approval names the public key that the approving device saw.

AuditEntry.description: One line of the audit log: who did it, what was done and when.

oneOf.description: Absent when the server itself acted.
Done with the host command, so the entry has no acting account.
The host command stored a new owner code. The entry does not contain the code.

replaced_a_code.description: True when a stored code stopped working because of the new one.

oneOf.description: The owner returned with a code that the host command issued.
The host command gave the event stream a new epoch, as after a restore.
States which invite created the account and which account created that invite.
An existing account used an invite to enter further workspaces.
An administrator added an existing account to the workspace.
The user limit or the setting that hides who is inside changed.
A moderator blocked the microphone of a person in the call of the channel.
A moderator blocked the sound of a person in the call of the channel.
A moderator removed a person from the call of the channel.

A moderator moved a person out of the call of the channel into another voice
channel. The entry does not name that channel.

A moderator moved a person into the call of the channel from another voice channel.
The entry does not name that channel.
A person in the call of the channel started a recording.

A recording of the call of the channel was stopped. The entry has no acting account
when the server stopped it.
A person removed a recording of the channel with its files and its transcript.
A person asked for the transcript of a recording of the channel again.

A person replaced the glossary of the workspace. The entry states the number of
terms, not the terms.

AuditEvent.description:
What was done. New actions are added; the fields of an existing action do not change.

An action that this build does not know is read as [`AuditEvent::Unknown`], so that a
client can show the entry with its time and its actor (ADR 0209). `Unknown` is never
written.

oneOf.description: Pass as `before` to read the next page. Absent on the last page.

Avatar.description:
The stored avatar of an account. The image itself is read from
`GET /api/v1/accounts/{account_id}/avatar`.

hash.description:
The SHA-256 hash of the image in lower-case hexadecimal. It changes when the image
changes, so a client keeps the image for as long as it sees the same hash.

Call.description: A call as an account that may see who is inside sees it.

participants.description: The people whom the media server lists in the room and whom the server allows there.

oneOf.description:
The recording of the call that is starting or runs. The people in the call see an
indicator while it is present (ADR 0601).

started_at.description: When the first person was seen in the room. Absent until then.

CallInvitation.description:
An invitation into a call: from a person inside a voice channel, or the ringing of a
direct-message call.

CallJoin.description:
What a device needs to join the room of a call. The token is valid for about one minute
and for the first connection only; a device that lost its connection for longer asks
again.

entry_requests.description: The requests to enter that wait for an answer of a person inside.

media_url.description: The address of the media server for the device.

CallMove.description:
A move of a person from one voice channel to another. The person's device joins the
destination first; the server takes the person out of the source when it has seen that
join (ADR 0511).

CallParticipant.description:
One person in a call. A block and the person's own setting are separate: removing a block
returns the microphone or the sound to `muted` or `deafened`.

deafened.description: The person's own sound setting, as their client reports it.

identity.description: The identity of the person's participant in the room of the media server.

muted.description: The person's own microphone setting, as their client reports it.

oneOf.description: The direct message of two accounts. `low_account_id` is the smaller identifier.

Challenge.description: A single-use challenge. The device signs [`Challenge::signing_input`].

oneOf.description: The account of the device key, when the key belongs to one.

ChallengeOperation.description: What a signed challenge is for. A challenge is accepted only by the route of its operation.

hides_occupants.description: True when a voice channel shows who is inside only to the people inside (ADR 0504).

permanent_messages.description: The channel setting that makes each message sent under it permanent.

user_limit.description:
The largest number of people in the call of a voice channel. Absent: no limit. A
person who is invited or moved in can pass it (ADR 0504).

ChannelCall.description: What an account that may see a voice channel learns of the call in it.

oneOf.description:
Absent when nobody is inside, and when the channel hides who is inside and the caller
is not inside (ADR 0504).

in_use.description: True while at least one person is in the room.

ChannelList.description: The channels and categories of a workspace that the caller can see.

ChannelOverride.description: The allow set and the deny set of one workspace role in one channel.

text.description: The corrected text: 1 to 2000 characters without control characters.

expires_at.description: Absent: the server's default lifetime applies.

Cursor.description:
A place in the order of the events of one server. An event with a position at or below the
position of a cursor is covered by the state that the cursor belongs to.

current.description: True for the device of the session that made the request.

DeviceOrigin.description: How a device key came to belong to its account.

DirectMute.description:
A muted direct-message conversation: the account that muted it gets no call invitation
from the other account (ADR 0515).

account_id.description: The other account of the conversation.

until.description: The time at which the mute ends. Absent: it lasts until it is turned off.

EntryRequest.description: A request of a person outside to enter a locked or full voice channel.

ErrorBody.description: The body of every response with a status of 400 or above.

ErrorCode.description:
The stable machine-readable code of an error. A client decides on the code, never on the
message.

A server can add codes within one API version (ADR 0209). A code that this build does not
know is read as [`ErrorCode::Unknown`]; the status of the response then tells the kind of
the error. `Unknown` is never written.

message.description: A sentence for a person who reads a log. Its text is not stable.

FileCheck.description: Whether the file of a segment passed the check of the server (ADR 0606).

FileProblem.description:
What the check found wrong with a file. Read with an unknown value as
[`RecordingStopReason`] is.

Glossary.description:
The glossary of a workspace: names and terms that the speech model receives before it
transcribes, most important first (ADR 0603).

GlossaryUse.description:
The terms of the glossary that the worker gave to the speech model, and those that did
not fit in its limit (ADR 0613).

Health.description: What the health route reports when the server can serve requests.

database.description: True when the server reached its database for this response.

failing_call_rooms.description:
The number of rooms of calls that the server could not check several times in a row,
while the media server answers otherwise. In such a room the server cannot remove a
person, and it lets nobody in.

media_server.description:
Whether the last admission check reached the media server. Absent on a server that
has no media server configured. While it is false, no call can be joined.

storage_low.description:
True while the free disk space of the recordings is at or below the reserve: the
server starts no recording and stops the ones that run (ADR 0006). Absent on a server
without a recorder, and when the free space cannot be read.

ImageType.description: The formats in which the server stores an avatar.

InviteCreated.description: The only response that carries the code of an invite.

JoinRequestStatus.description: The result that the waiting device collects with its device key.

oneOf.description: Present once the request is approved. The device then logs in.

Meeting.description: Meeting mode: every microphone except the presenter's is blocked (ADR 0505).

position.description: Public sequence position; private system lines share the latest public position.

mentions.description: Exact through 99; 100 means 100 or more unread mentions.

unread.description: Exact through 99; 100 means 100 or more unread messages.

MicrophoneBlock.description: A block of a person's microphone. The server enforces it: the person cannot send audio.

MuteDirectConversation.description: An absent `until` mutes the conversation until the mute is turned off.

Origin.description: The scheme, the host and the port of a server address, without a path: `https://chat.example.test`

server_permissions.description: The union of the permissions of the account's server roles.

OwnCall.description: The call that the account is in, and the device that it is in the call with.

oneOf.description: Absent when the account is in no call.

PendingDeviceLink.description: A device link that waits for the approval of a device of the account.

Proof.description: The answer to a challenge. The challenge names the device key that must have signed it.

origin.description:
The origin that the device connected to and signed. The server accepts the proof only
when it is one of its own public origins.

Recording.description: A recording without its segments. Events and lists carry this form.

bytes.description: The bytes of the files of the recording. Absent until the files are processed.

ended_at.description: When the last job of the recorder had ended. Absent while the recording is active.

failed_segments.description: The number of segments that failed. The segments state what was saved of each.

oneOf.description: Present with the state `failed`.

language.description:
`auto`, or the language code that the person who started the recording set for the
transcript (ADR 0603).

recording_since.description: When the first job of the recorder was started. Absent before.

requested_at.description: When the recording was asked for.

segments.description: The number of segments of the recording.

oneOf.description: Present from the moment a stop is asked for.

timeline_started_at.description:
The first sample of the earliest file of the recording. The times of the transcript
count from it. Absent until the files are processed, and without a file.

transcript_lines.description: The number of lines of the transcript.

RecordingDetail.description: A recording with its segments, in the order in which they were asked for.

RecordingFailure.description:
Why nothing of a recording was saved. Read with an unknown value as
[`RecordingStopReason`] is.

oneOf.description: Pass as `before` to read the next page. Absent on the last page.

RecordingSegment.description: One file of a recording: the composite, or one audio track of one person.

oneOf.description: The person whose track the segment records. Absent for the composite.

duration_ms.description: The length of the file in milliseconds, as the recorder reports it.

oneOf.description: Present with the state `failed`.

The file, after the recording was processed. Absent before, and when no file was
found. `GET /api/v1/recordings/{recording_id}/segments/{segment_id}/file` returns
its bytes.

requested_at.description: When the server asked the recorder for the job.

started_at.description:
The start of the file, as the recorder reports it. Absent until the recorder has
reported it. Of a failed segment, `started_at` and `ended_at` state the time range
that was saved, as far as the recorder reported it.

RecordingState.description:
The state of a recording. The states follow each other in this order; the last three are
final.

oneOf.description: The person who stopped the recording. Absent when the server stopped it.

RecordingStopReason.description:
Why a recording was stopped. A server can add reasons within one API version; a reason
that this build does not know is read as [`RecordingStopReason::Unknown`], which is never
written (ADR 0209).

RecoveryNotice.description:
One recovery of an account, as the account sees it. A device keeps the notice of a
recovery until it acknowledges it (ADR 0112).

oneOf.description: Absent when the recovery was done with the host command.

RedeemInvite.description: Sent by a logged-in account to enter the workspaces of an invite.

workspace_ids.description: The workspaces that the account entered with this redemption.

name.description: The name of the voice: 1 to 64 characters.

ReportCallState.description: The device's report of the person's own microphone and sound settings.

RequestDeviceLink.description: Sent by a new device that has no account on this server yet.

RequestToJoin.description: A join request carries a name and nothing else about the person.

SegmentFailure.description: Why a segment failed. Read with an unknown value as [`RecordingStopReason`] is.

SegmentFile.description: The file of a segment as the server found and checked it.

duration_ms.description: The length of the media in milliseconds.

media_type.description: `video/mp4` for the composite and `audio/ogg` for an audio track.

recovered.description:
The recorder did not end the file in order: the server took it from what a lost
recorder left.

silent.description:
The sound of the whole file is digital silence. A microphone that was muted for the
whole recording gives such a file.

starts_at.description:
The first sample of the file on the timeline of the recording. Absent when the
recorder reported no time for the file.

width.description: The size of the picture of the composite.

SegmentReason.description:
Why a segment is damaged, failed or not transcribed. Read with an unknown value as
[`TranscriptFailure`] is.

SegmentTranscription.description: How much of one audio file the transcript covers (ADR 0611).

ServerId.description: Identifies one server. A client stores it with the server address.

ServerInfo.description: What a server tells any caller before the caller has an account.

logo_path.description: The path of the logo on this server, when the server has one.

ServerPermission.description: A permission that acts on the whole server. The number is the bit of the stored set.

recoveries.description:
The recoveries of the account that this device has not acknowledged. A login does not
remove them (ADR 0112).

SetChannelOverride.description: Two empty sets remove the override.

terms.description:
At most 200 terms of 1 to 200 characters each, most important first, without
duplicates.

ShareAudio.description: The sound that a screen share sends (ADR 0502).

Snapshot.description:
The state that a client starts from or returns to. It contains the effect of every event
up to `cursor` and of no later one, so a subscription with `cursor` continues it without a
gap (ADR 0207). It carries the account, its workspaces, and their roles, categories and
channels, and the calls in progress that the caller may see. The other collections are
loaded on demand from their routes: members, accounts,
devices, invites, join requests, server roles and channel overrides. A client that loads
one of them applies to it the events that arrived since it asked for it, in their order.

call_invitations.description: The invitations into calls that wait for an answer of the account.

direct_calls.description: The direct-message calls of the account that are in progress.

direct_mutes.description: The direct-message conversations that the account has muted.

oneOf.description: The call that the account is in.

threads.description: The newest 200 readable threads with unread replies or mentions.

threads_more.description: Whether additional unread threads can be requested.

workspaces.description: The workspaces that the caller can see.

SoundBlock.description: A block of a person's sound. The client of the person applies it (ADR 0503).

SpeakerSeparation.description: Whether the lines of a segment of shared sound have speaker labels (ADR 0614).

SpeakersReason.description: Why labels are missing. Read with an unknown value as [`TranscriptFailure`] is.

language.description:
The language of the speech, as a Whisper language code of two or three lower-case
letters. Absent or `auto`: the language of each speech clip is detected (ADR 0603).

StreamEpoch.description: Identifies one history of event positions. It changes when positions start again.

Transcript.description: The transcript of a recording without its lines.

oneOf.description: Present with the state `failed`.

language.description: `auto`, or the language that the person who started the recording set.

segments.description:
One result for each audio segment of the recording. Empty until the transcript is
built.

TranscriptFailure.description:
Why no transcript was built. A server can add reasons within one API version; a reason
that this build does not know is read as [`TranscriptFailure::Unknown`], which is never
written (ADR 0209).

TranscriptLine.description: One line of a transcript: one speech clip.

account_id.description: The person of the microphone, or the person whose screen share holds the sound.

oneOf.description: The person who made the newest correction.

language.description: The language that the speech model used for the line.

line.description: The position of the line in the transcript, from 0.

original_text.description: The text of the worker. Present when the line was corrected.

speaker.description:
The number of the voice in shared sound. Absent for a microphone and for a line
without a label.

start_ms.description: Milliseconds from the start of the timeline of the recording.

text.description: The newest correction, or the text of the worker.

lines.description: In the order of the timeline.

next_after.description: Pass as `after` to read the next page. Absent on the last page.

TranscriptSegment.description: The result of the transcript for one audio segment of the recording.

audio_ms.description: The length of the audio that the worker decoded, in milliseconds.

processed_ms.description: The lines cover the audio from the start of the file to this point.

oneOf.description: Present with the status `damaged`, `failed` or `not_transcribed`.
Present when labels are missing.

TranscriptSpeaker.description:
One voice in the shared sound of one person. The worker numbers the voices of a
recording; a person can give a voice a name.

account_id.description: The person whose shared sound holds the voice.

name.description: The name that a person gave to the voice. Absent: the label `Speaker N` is shown.

oneOf.description: The person who gave the name.

TranscriptState.description: The state of the transcript of a recording.

UnreadThreads.description: One page of threads with unread replies or mentions, newest first.

next.description: Opaque continuation for the next unread-thread page.

UpdateCallSettings.description: An absent field keeps its value. `user_limit: null` removes the limit.

UpdateCategory.description: An absent field keeps its value.

UpdateChannel.description: An absent field keeps its value. `category_id: null` takes the channel out of its category.

UpdateServerRole.description: An absent field keeps its value.

UpdateWorkspaceRole.description: An absent field keeps its value.

is_default.description: True for the workspace that an invite or an approval grants when it names none.

WorkspacePermission.description: A permission inside one workspace. The number is the bit of the stored set.

is_everyone.description: True for the role that every member of the workspace holds. It is never assigned.

calls.description: The voice channels, of the ones the caller can see, that have a call.

channels.description: The channels that the caller can see.

own_role_ids.description: The roles of the workspace that the caller holds, without the "everyone" role.

session.description: The token of a session, from a login.
